findings.recommendation: Configure HSTS on HTTPS sites after confirming all required subdomains support HTTPS.

findings.evidence: Response did not include this header.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options
findings.evidence: Response did not include this header.
findings.recommendation: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN, or use CSP frame-ancestors.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.evidence: Response did not include this header.
findings.recommendation: Consider strict-origin-when-cross-origin or a policy suitable for the site.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy
findings.evidence: Response did not include this header.
findings.recommendation: Set a policy that disables features the application does not need.

notes: This is a lightweight header/configuration review, not a penetration test.
A missing header is not proof that a site is vulnerable; assess application context.
